title: Recovering a bit from a nested encoding
statement: Let $x$, $w$, and $r$ be finite strings of bits, and let $i$ be a natural number with $i<|w|$. In the encoding of $x$ paired with the encoding of $w$ paired with $r$, the bit at position $2|x|+2+2i$, taking the default value false if that position is out of range, is equal to the bit at position $i$ of $w$, again taking false as the default.
